newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-NZ WIN TOSS AND BAT AFTER DELAYED START.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NZ WIN TOSS AND BAT AFTER DELAYED START.

text.p: New Zealand won the toss and elected to bat in the second cricket test against England on Thursday at Wellington's Basin Reserve ground.
Heavy overnight rain delayed the start of play by 4-1/2 hours. However, one hour's lost time can be made up at the scheduled end of today's play.
New Zealand left out batsman Chris Harris from their lineup, ensuring left-arm spinner Daniel Vettori will become the country's youngest-ever test player, at 18 years 10 days.
England have made two changes following the drawn first test in Auckland last week.
Fast-medium Andrew Caddick, who was born in New Zealand, comes in for left-armer Alan Mullally and offspinner Robert Croft replaces allrounder Craig White.
New Zealand: Lee Germon (captain), Bryan Young, Blair Pocock, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Nathan Astle, Chris Cairns, Dipak Patel, Simon Doull, Geoff Allott, Daniel Vettori.
England: Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Dominic Cork, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andrew Caddick, Phil Tufnell.
